description: Fetch details of a single Twitch video (VOD) by URL or numeric ID (twitch.tv/videos/{id}). Returns title, channel (name/display name/url), game/category (name/slug/url), duration, view count, publish date, description, thumbnail, and chapter markers ({title, startAt} in seconds) when present. Chat replay is a real-time message stream, so it is intentionally not included. No login required; subscriber-only VODs may be inaccessible. Runs in the user's browser (internal Twitch GraphQL).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full Twitch video URL (https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2577728783) or just the numeric video id (2577728783). URLs come from twitch/get-channel-videos or twitch/search --type video results. Required.
